question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Honest:** telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing.
 
• Only that person can be trusted who is **honest**. 
 
• All **other given options** are also positive characteristics of a person. But, honesty is necessary for being trusted.
 
• ​Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is honest.
 
• The correct answer is **option 2.**
